items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think Walter was with the band at that time, Walter Fuller. I think Fuller was with Hines at that particular time also. But anyway, I -- you know, this was one of the -- he was one of the guys who really, really, really did impress me.

ctx.x: But I don't think they ever did a performance where his violin wasn't included.

Well, he was playing the violin. This stuck out in my mind, you know, with Ray, with Hines, when they played the Grand Terrace, and I think Walter was with the band at that time, Walter Fuller. I think Fuller was with Hines at that particular time also. But anyway, I -- you know, this was one of the -- he was one of the guys who really, really, really did impress me. I was so thrilled and impressed with his style, you know. And Nat, getting back to Nat King Cole, when I heard Nat, Nat reminded me so very much of…
